item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council is scheduled to vote Monday on a proposed land use change in Tradition that would convert nearly 9.5 acres near Crosstown Parkway and SW Fairgreen Drive from residential to commercial designation. item.title: TCCEED doubles employer participation in second year of paid summer internship program
item.description: The Treasure Coast workforce development initiative placed 61 students in local jobs this summer as applications from area students tripled from the previous year.

item.title: Linda Noskova wins first Grand Slam title at Wimbledon after blowing five match points
item.description: The 21-year-old Czech player recovered from a second-set collapse to defeat Karolina Muchova in an all-Czech final on Saturday.

item.title: Florida Man Loses Home to Hurricane Milton Months After Paying Off Mortgage
item.description:
A Florida homeowner who paid off his mortgage found himself facing catastrophic financial loss when Hurricane Milton tore the roof off his house just two months later. The homeowner had no insurance coverage at the time of the storm and was forced to pay for all repairs out of pocket.

item.title: Martin County brush fires contained as Florida Forest Service warns more expected this summer
item.description:
Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike. Both fires are now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Lightning strike ignites one of two Martin County brush fires this week
item.description: Martin County experienced two brush fires this week, with lightning causing at least one of the blazes.

item.title: Florida Forest Service urges Martin County residents to report all brush fires immediately
item.description: Officials say residents should never assume someone else has already called in a brush fire.

item.title: Summer heat creates peak brush fire season in Martin County
item.description: The Florida Forest Service says Martin County is in the middle of peak brush fire season due to extreme summer conditions.

item.title: Martin County brush fires can smolder underground before resurfacing days later
item.description: Florida Forest Service officials explain that some brush fires travel underground after lightning strikes.

item.title: Florida Forest Service monitoring two contained brush fire sites in Martin County
item.description: Both brush fires that ignited this week in Martin County are now fully contained.

item.title: Martin County residents should not be alarmed by brush fire season, officials say
item.description: The Florida Forest Service says conditions fueling brush fires will continue but residents should remain calm.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
